## Alapolo (CR 17)

**XP** 102,400  
CN Medium fey  
**Init** +11; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +25  


**Defense**


**AC** 32, touch 32, flat-footed 24 (+14 deflection, +7 Dex, +1 dodge)  
**hp** 350 (25d6+200)  
**Fort** +17, **Ref** +21, **Will** +19  
**Defensive Abilities** shifting shadows; **Immune** one with shadows  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** 2 shadow claws +20 touch (3d10+14/19–20)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with shadow claws)  
**Special Attacks** cloying pull, enticing invitation, weighty shadow  


**Tactics**


**During Combat** The alapolo uses Enticing Invitation on as many creatures as possible. It then alternates between using Weighty Shadow and attacking with its shadow claws.  

**Morale** If reduced to fewer than 50 hit points, the alapolo attempts to flee.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 25, **Con** 24, **Int** 11, **Wis** 20, **Cha** 25  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 44  
**Feats** Acrobatic Steps, [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), Combat Casting, Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Critical (shadow claw), Improved Initiative, Nimble Moves, Skill Focus (Perform [dance]), Spring Attack, Weapon Focus (shadow claw), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Great Fortitude](../../rules/feats/great-fortitude.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; Agile Maneuvers and Weapon Finesse are one feat, Weapon Finesse; in their place: Toughness, Great Fortitude; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +32 (+36 to jump), Bluff +30, Diplomacy +30, Knowledge (planes) +25, Perception +25, Perform (dance) +37, Stealth +35  
**Languages** Common, Sylvan  


**Special Abilities**


**Cloying Pull (Su)** As an immediate action, the alapolo attempts to snag a creature moving out of the alapolo’s reach. The creature must succeed on a DC 29 Reflex save or its movement ends. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Enticing Invitation (Sp)** The alapolo whispers an invitation to a target within 30 feet of it, affecting it with the irresistible dance spell (Will save DC 25). If the save is successful and after the target spends one round dancing, it is immune to this alapolo’s Enticing Invitation for 24 hours. At the end of each round the target is subjected to this effect, it takes 1d4 Con damage. If the alapolo uses Weighty Shadow against the target, the effect ends.  

**One with Shadows (Su)** The alapolo is immune spells and effects with the darkness or light descriptor, as well as to spells from the shadow subschool.  

**Shifting Shadows (Su)** The alapolo’s movement doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity.  

**Weighty Shadow (Su)** As a standard action, the alapolo petulantly stomps on an adjacent shadow. The target’s shadow becomes incredibly heavy to drag around, reducing all the target’s speeds by 20 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet) for 1 minute.
